name: linux_edr_recon
author: jm33-ng
comment: Audit local Linux EDR/kernel telemetry: processes, filesystem artifacts, kernel modules, tracefs kprobes/ftrace, LSM stack, perf-attached BPF

parameters.name: section
parameters.description: Comma-separated sections: all, procs, arts, mods, kprobes, ftrace, lsm, perf, avail. 'avail' reads available_filter_functions and can be large; it is excluded from 'all'

name: linux_env_scrape
author: jm33-ng
comment: Harvest secrets and SSH agent sockets from /proc/<pid>/environ

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: secrets (values with a secret-looking key), ssh (SSH_AUTH_SOCK only), or all

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: own (only processes with the agent's uid) or all (every readable process)

name: linux_proc_fd_scan
author: jm33-ng
comment: Find processes holding credential/secret files open by scanning /proc/<pid>/fd symlinks

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Only report fd targets containing this substring (empty = built-in credential path list)

parameters.name: pid
parameters.description: Scan a single PID instead of every process

name: linux_sysctl_audit
author: jm33-ng
comment: Show security-relevant kernel sysctls (dmesg/kptr restrict, perf_event_paranoid, ptrace_scope, BPF JIT/disable, modules_disabled)
